verdict.rationale: Snoozing exists only by implication: community notes on the free-plan 90-day limit mention snoozed emails that 'still arrive in the inbox', so threads resurface after a snooze. No evidence shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies, and scheduled send is a different capability. Missing for 10: first-party snooze documentation, a no-reply follow-up reminder feature, any detail on snooze options or resurfacing behavior.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: snoozed emails past that window won't show up in search results (though they still arrive in the inbox)
They worried the free plan's 90-day limit could hide emails snoozed for longer.
